It’s a milestone moment and a celebration of the community that’s brought us this far. Whether you're in it for glory or a good time, this is your invitation to show up, stand out, and win big. [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/88ced992e280dae7868d3698c349a7a51f72fc65.png"][/img][/p][h1]🔥CHECK OUT THE CHANGES🔥[/h1][p][/p][h2]Greetings, Champions![/h2][p]Welcome to our latest Wildcard patch! This update brings major improvements, bug fixes, and new gameplay features designed to smooth out match flow, enhance combat clarity, and empower your strategic play. We've addressed core movement issues, revamped match startup logic, fine-tuned champions, and introduced new tools like the KO Recap and Lobby system. There’s also a brand-new Chronos Arena to explore, alongside meaningful updates to summons, mechanics, and UI elements. Dive into all the changes below![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506111/cc5562f0c3cda22def564b741368dd645d8cdf16.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]General[/h3][list][*][p]Jumps now have decreased horizontal movement if you spam them[/p][/*][*][p]Champions' movement speed is decreased when close to the Core by 30%[/p][/*][*][p]Turned motion blur off by default[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where champions could start to capture the Wild Card or Core while dashing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could dash into a vent and stay in it[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where controller sensitivity was not working[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Wild Card would not spawn[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where fire and knockback are not counted from the source, so neither the champion nor the summon will get credit for the KOs and damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed summons attacks to check for line of sight, being alive, and in range before connecting the attack. This helps to address summons doing damage on KO and through the floors.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where throwing a card would cause the champions to get stuck inside a summon[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where champions could be picked at the same time[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where champions could be the same if no champion was picked[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New[/h3][list][*][p][b]Can now hold to attack[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Added in UI element around reticle so you know when a hold ability can be released[/b][/p][list][*][p]Lockes hover[/p][/*][*][p]Bolgars Sprint[/p][/*][*][p]Werebears Leap[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Lobby Feature[/b][/p][list][*][p]To support the efforts of our organized play, we wanted players to be able to create a lobby game.[/p][/*][*][p]These lobbies have 4 players and will create a game with those 4 players.[/p][/*][*][p]You can only invite someone to a lobby if they are your friend[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Match Flow[/b][/p][list][*][p]We were seeing issues where players would load into the game at different times and gain an advantage by attacking before the other team loaded in.[/p][/*][*][p]The new match flow helps to address that issue.[/p][/*][*][p]Match Steps[/p][list][*][p]Hit Play[/p][/*][*][p]Enter champion select[/p][/*][*][p]Choose your champion and deck[/p][list][*][p]If all players choose what they want to play, the timer will skip to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players load into the map in a pre-game phase.[/p][list][*][p]Players can now ready up to start the match OR wait until the timer expires.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players will then see the VS screen.[/p][/*][*][p]After the VS screen, the match will start, and players will spawn in the dugout.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]KO Recap Feature[/b][/p][list][*][p]A lot of times in Wildcard, it may be hard to tell what KO’d you or did damage to you. Now, after each time you are KO’d, you will be presented with where the damage came from.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Arenas and Layouts[/b][/p][list][*][p]Chronos Arena[/p][/*][*][p]Mainline Layout[/p][list][*][p]Vents no longer send cards or champions as far[/p][list][*][p][i]We were seeing gameplay be about venting over to the other side too much just to try and end the game or do damage. notes.title: Alpha 3 is Here!
notes.notes:
ALPHA 3 IS HERE!
We are kicking off playtesting for Alpha 3 this weekend, while the team is at LVL UP, and have extended playtest hours to get more players into the game! 

[u][b]Extended Playtesting Hours for this Week:[/b][/u]
4/25: 5pm - 11pm CST  (April 25, 10:00 PM – April 26, 4:00 AM UTC)
4/26 11am- 6pm CST  (April 26, 4:00 PM – 11:00 PM UTC)

[h1][b]PATCH NOTES[/b][/h1]  
[h2][i]4.25 Update[/i][/h2]  

[h2]GENERAL[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Can now see champion abilities in the TAB/Select screen in-game  
[*]All dashes are immune to slows while dashing  
[i]Players were experiencing getting double slowed, so using a dash to cleanse a slow was not working as intended.[/i]  
[*]All Ultimates are immune to slows while activating  
[i]Since ultimates are no longer immune to damage, if a player is slowed while using an ultimate, it’s too hard of a counter to shut it down and KO the player.[/i]  
[*]Now immune when walking out of the dugout for 2 seconds  
[*]Can cast and use abilities once having left the dugout  
[/list]

[h2]WILDCARDS[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Changed from [b]5 → 3[/b] in a deck  
[*]When a Wildcard is captured, a [b]90-second timer[/b] will start  
[*]If the timer runs out, the Wildcards are removed from the players  
[*]If a player is KO’d, the Wildcards are removed from them  
[*]If a player gets a KO, the timer is increased by [b]10 seconds[/b]  
[*]If a player picks up a new Wildcard, the timer resets to [b]90 seconds[/b]  
[/list]

[h2]CHAMPIONS[/h2]

[h3]Neva[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Fixed bug with her getting stuck  
[*]Fixed bug not being able to use Sidekick  
[*]Fixed bug with XO not returning to her  
[/list]

[h3]Hack Mechanic[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Hack no longer prevents summoning  
[/list]

[h3]Dash[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Now cleanses slows  
[/list]

[h3]Ultimate[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Now Hacks on activation  
[*]Increased movement speed from [b]600 → 900[/b]  
[*]Increased attack speed from [b]0.7 → 1[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Ragna[/h3]  
[b]Sidekick[/b]  
[list]  
[*]Changed from global → [b]50m[/b]  
[/list]

[h2]SUMMONS[/h2]

[h3]Vitadrop[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Lifelink healing changed from [b]50% → 100%[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Broc[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Lifelink healing changed from [b]50% → 100%[/b]  
[*]Damage changed from [b]50 → 35[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Buckshot[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Each consecutive hit increases the damage done to a maximum of [b]100[/b] per shot  
[*]Starting damage is [b]40[/b]  
[*]Increased damage per shot is [b]20[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Lumph[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Replaced instant Overheal with Overheal-over-time ability  
[*]Increased total overhealing done to [b]100 HP over 5 seconds[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]RB-IT[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Fixed a bug where dashing after being hit by RB-IT would not cleanse the Time Dilation  
[/list]

[h3]Burnout[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Fire Trail duration decreased from [b]5 → 1 seconds[/b]  
[*]Fire Trail damage increased from [b]35 → 50[/b]  
[/list]

[h3]Skye[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Fixed to apply Overclocked all the time  
[*]Fixed to cleanse slows  
[/list]

[h3]Heartburn[/h3]  
[list]  
[*]Increased fireball size (radius) by [b]50%[/b]  
[*]Increased fireball travel speed by [b]10%[/b]  
[*]Increased fireball damage [b]40 → 50[/b]  
[*]Fireball now correctly deals [b]FIRE[/b] damage  
[/list]

[h2]GAMEPLAY EFFECTS[/h2]  
[i]The following effects no longer stack:[/i]  
[list]  
[*]Overclocked won't stack  
[*]Enrage won't stack  
[*]Time Dilation won't stack  
[/list]

[h2]UI[/h2]  
[list]  
[*]Deck building screen UI updated  
[*]Champion select screen UI updated  
[/list]

[h2]KNOWN ISSUES[/h2]  
[list]  
[*][b]Goalie Health Bar[/b]  
On occasion, the goalie health bar will not reflect the damage the goalie has taken. It’s a HUD issue only — the goalie will take damage and be KO’d as expected.  

[*][b]End of Match Rewards[/b]  
The rewards UI shown at the end of a match can show [b]+0 coins[/b]. Coins are being awarded as expected, and the coin count does update to reflect your actual rewards.  

[*][b]Challenges[/b]  
The Challenges UI may not update, even though your progress toward completing the challenge is being captured.  
[/list]

We can't wait to see you in the arena and get your feedback! We appreciate your help!
